== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Used to be very well known under his previous account username "Adam 16 Ans TerS" in the French scene.
* Known for his aggressive playstyle
* He is good friends with [[Akabane]] and [[NUCLEARINT]] (previously teammates in [[Kameto Corp]]).
* In 2019, he submitted a clip to Fnatic for their Guess My ELO series.<ref>https://youtu.be/e7i7nun5oP8?t=560</ref> It was a clip of [[TF Blade]]'s {{ci|Irelia}} getting outplayed by his {{ci|Darius}}.
** The players who reviewed his clip, [[Bwipo]] and [[Hylissang]], became his teammates in Fnatic in May 2021.
* Plays without in-game sounds and with a custom music soundtrack allowed by referees due to having tinnitus.
* During Worlds 2023, fans jokingly referred to the Worlds song "GODS" when describing his champion pool. It is also an acronym for "'''G'''aren - '''O'''laf - '''D'''arius - '''S'''ett".<ref>[https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/1713483277435338815 LoL Esports' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* French casters call him "Le Petit Prince".<ref>[https://twitter.com/OTP_LoL/status/1403442459401654277 OTP's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
=== Individual Awards ===
* EU 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (Summer 2021, Spring 2023)
